join: blueprint Output and every requirement leaf carry a CIG UUID; nothing here is matched by name.
part_join: the ship page's part key against blueprint Output.Class, case-folded, exact. The display-name route is refused: it adds 34 and one of them is a different class sharing a name.
rows_are_two_kinds: demand.json holds 37 rows and they are NOT one population. 26 are RESOURCES, measured in SCU of cargo, and 11 are hand-mined GEMS, counted one at a time as items. The two are never summed and must never be reported as one number: '37 materials' is the mistake C1 made in the C3 mining order on 2026-08-28 and C3 caught it. Read scu_total for the first kind and item_total for the second; a row uses one or the other, never both.
tier_rule: tier 0 only - higher tiers are the same build at better quality and would double-count.
unit_rule: SCU (a `resource` leaf) and COUNT (an `item` leaf) are reported separately and never summed. The recipe count is the figure that spans both.
